system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; describes per-agent LLM calls with inputs (Eq. 2) but no system prompt mechanism; no repo in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent must actively explore the environment to gather critical information about both the task and the functionality of the web elements
env_context_strategy.note: Web environment; the observation is the actree of the current page.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history-management description. Explorer receives action history Ht plus reflections; no config surface available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: WebPilot operates as a text-only agent, leveraging the accessibility tree, i.e., actree, of the webpage without relying on visual observations

tool_call_format.note: Actions like "click link 'Members'" shown in Fig. 1; the parsing syntax is not described.

tool_count.note: Action space is inherited from WebArena and is not enumerated in the paper.

edit_primitive.note: Web agent; no file-editing tool registry available in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependencies available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the Local Optimization phase executes each subtask using a tailored MCTS designed for complex environments
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1: Planner plan then per-subtask MCTS; Controller re-executes incomplete subtasks with reflection.

planning_granularity.note: The plan P is a stored subtask list, updated by RTA and executed by a separate set of agents. Coded hierarchical; explicit_plan_object is the alternative reading.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Specifically, the Global Optimization phase is driven by Planner, Controller, and Extractor.
multi_agent_topology.note: Role-specialised LLM agents (Planner, Controller, Extractor, Explorer, Verifier, Appraiser) in a fixed algorithmic sequence. orchestrator_workers is a possible alternative reading.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Explorer, Verifier, and Appraiser work together to complete the task.

human_in_loop.note: Described as autonomous; no config surface to confirm absence of HITL.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: RTA: Controller assesses the completeness of the subtask T1, generates subtask reflection Rsub if needed and updates the current planP
short_term_state.note: State includes the plan, search tree Q-values, and reflections.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Appraiser evaluates both the effectiveness of the executed action at and the potential of the result-ing observation ot+1
self_verification.note: Appraiser and Controller are role-prompted LLMs scoring the output; the paper does not say whether this is the same model or a separate judge. llm_judge is arguable.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the completeness assessment indicates that the subtask is not complete, Con- troller initiates a re-execution of the subtask.
retry_policy.note: Subtask-level re-execution; no retry cap is stated.

rollback.note: MCTS backtracking implies environment state restoration, but the paper does not describe the mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: we limit the max node count per subtask to 10
termination_condition.note: Controller decides when a subtask is complete (Eq. 7); the node count cap is per subtask.

cost_controls.note: The 4096 max-tokens setting is a per-call generation limit, not a budget.

execution_isolation.note: Uses WebArena environments; the execution boundary is not described.

permission_model.note: The Verifier checks action validity and uniqueness, but this is not an authorisation model.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on WebArena and MiniWoB++, but repo contents are not available.

guardrails.note: The Verifier validates actions for non-redundancy, but this is not described as a safety control.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A Versatile and Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Web Task Execution with Strategic Exploration

open_source.note: The paper claims "Our code is publicly released at github.com/WebPilot", but no licence or repo is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Only OpenAI models were evaluated; no client abstraction is described.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our code is publicly released at github.com/WebPilot.
primary_artifact.note: No repo URL or version is in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: Based on the paper v1 date as a fallback; no tag or commit is available.

pinned_version.note: No repo or version is in the evidence; the paper is arXiv 2408.15978v1.
